Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, S.H. KAPADIA
B Transfer of Property Act, 1882-Section 52-General principles-Held: Litigant party is exempted from taking notice of title acquired during pendency of litigation-Principle of lis pende'1s is of public policy, where good faith C or bona fide do not arise-Transferee pendente lite is bound by decree from dealing with the suit property-Only property alienated with the permission of the Court could affect rights of other party under decree passed in the suit-Thus, order of High Court that transferees pendente lite without leave of the court could be added as parties in the suit, is set D
Decision Date : 08-12-2006 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5664/2006 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
